content: Ndekléá mlɩbɩ́ɩ ɩprɩ́ɩ ánɩ́ ndɛprɩ́ɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́nsʋ́, mlɩa ɔpasua ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ Laodikea pʋ́ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmɔkʋ́wun mɩ kɩ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ nwunsʋ.
Ndɛ mʋ́ bwɛ pʋ́wá amʋ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n, abʋbwɛ kʋlɛ, dwɛ aba, nu asʋ́n asɩ wankláán, mɛ́nɩ bónu Bulu asʋ́n ŋaínhɛ́ amʋ́ʋ́ igyi Kristo amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ asɩ.
Kristotɔ Bulu lɔ́pʋ mʋ atonyahɛ́á igyi mʋ nyánsa pʋ́ mʋ asʋ́nbɩ fɛ́ɛ́ wá.
Ndɛ mlɩ asʋ́n ánfɩ bláa, mɛ́nɩ ɔhaa mɔ́ɔpʋ asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɩbʋ anulɛ́ kʋkʋ bɛmlɛ́ mlɩ.
Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á mbʋ ɩfɔ́ mlɩ wá, támɛ ntosúsu mlɩ ɩwɩ brégyíbrɛ́. Ansɩ́ ɛ́ ɩdɛ mɩ́ gyí ánɩ́ mlɩtsie wankláán, mlɩlɩ́ɩ́ kínkíínkín Kristosʋ hógyitɔ.
Ɩ́nɩá mlɩlahɔ Kristo Yesu gyi ánɩ́ mʋgyí mlɩ Wíe sʋ á, mlɩyɔ mʋ́sʋ́ mlɩa mʋnyɔ amlɩbwɛ kʋlɛ.

Mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩhɩɛ lɩɩ kínkíínkín Kristo hógyitɔ, amlɩnya ɔwʋnlɩ́n tsu mlɩa mʋnyɔ ɩkʋlɛbwɛtɔ. Mlɩyɔ mʋ́sʋ́ amlɩhɔ mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋdɛ mlɩ suná, igyi ɔnɔkwalɩ amʋ, fɛ́ alɩá oyí nlín tɔyɔ́ ɔtɔ́tɔ́ɔ́tɔ́, yódúnká ntsu há mʋ́ ɩtɛdan, amlɩda Bulu ɩpán ɛ́ brégyíbrɛ́.

Mlɩmáha ɔkpa ɔhaa ɔmlɛ mlɩ, pʋ mʋ ansɩtɩ́ɩn mʋ́a afunu asʋ́n ánɩ́ igyi amándɩ́ɛ́á anyánkpʋ́sa bɔwa kʋkʋ, itsú ɔŋɛ́ ntɛ́ɛ túmiá ɩdɛ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩsʋ gyí, imotsú Kristo wá bɛha amlɩmli mʋ nkpábi.
Tsúfɛ́ Kristotɔ Bulu tsiátɔ́ onutónutó ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ ɩbʋ nyankpʋsa ɔkpasʋ.
Ɩ́nɩá mlɩa Kristonyɔ mlɩlabwɛ́ kʋlɛ sʋ mlɩlafʋn. Mʋgyí ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔbʋ túmi ɔŋɛ́tɔ́ atúmipʋ pʋ́ ɩsʋ agyípʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́.
Mlɩa mʋnyɔ ɩkʋlɛbwɛ sʋ aladɩ́nkɩ́ mlɩ tsiátɔ́ dada amʋ lɛ́ mlɩsʋ fɛ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋtɛtɩn keté, dɩ́nkɩ́ awʋlɩ lɛ́ mʋ́sʋ́ ámʋ.

Brɛ́á bɔbɔ mlɩ asú á, bopulá mlɩ tsiátɔ́ dada amʋ fɛ́ alɩá bopulá Kristo; Bulu lɔ́kʋsʋ́a mlɩ ba nkpatɔ fɛ́ alɩá ɔlɔkʋsʋ́a Kristo, tsúfɛ́ mlɩlóhogyi ánɩ́ Bulu bʋ túmi kʋ́sʋ́a mʋ tsú afúlitɔ.

Tɛkɩ mlɩ lakpan pʋ́ mlɩ tsiátɔ́ dada amʋ́ʋ́ bʋmɔkʋ́dɩ́nkɩ́ lɛ́ mlɩsʋ ámʋ sʋ mlɩlówu fɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔmɔkʋ́tɩn keté. Támɛ séi á, Bulu lakʋ́sʋ́a anɩa Kristonyɔ ba nkpa pɔpwɛtɔ, alasí anɩ lakpan fɛ́ɛ́ kíé anɩ.
Ɔlɛdɩnkɩ́ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Mose mblatɔ, ɩdɛ anɩ ɩlá lɛ ámʋ lɛ́ anɩsʋ, yɛ́da mʋ́ mántá Kristo oyikpalíhɛ amʋsʋ.
Bulu lɔ́swɩɩ́ ɔŋɛ́tɔ́ atúmipʋ pʋ́ ɩsʋ agyípʋ́ túmi, ɔlɛkɩtá amʋ́ ndoun, lɛ́ amʋ́ ɔwan, wá amʋ́ pɛ́lɩtɔ, brɛ́ olegyi amʋ́sʋ́ Kristo oyikpalíhɛ amʋsʋ.
Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩmáha ɔhaa ɔlɛ mlɩ ɩlá mlɩ atogyihɛ, mlɩ atonuhɛ, nkegyí, ɔtsra pɔpwɛ nkɛ, ntɛ́ɛ Yudafɔ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́ aná sʋ.
Yiyí kɛkɛ ɩ́nɩ fɛ́ɛ́ igyi há atɔ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbɛ́ba amʋ onutó. Mʋ́ onutónutó ámʋ lɛ́lɩn ɔwan Kristotɔ.
Mlɩmáha ɔkpa ɔhaa ɔmlɛ mlɩ amlɩba ɩwɩasɩ sum Bulu-abɔpʋ, amlɩhʋlɩ ɩpán ánɩ́ Bulu lɛ́hɩɛ yáɩ́ mlɩ. Nɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ alawun tɔkʋ tsú mʋ́ ɩwɩ kʋ́ráá pó á, ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ansɩtɩ́ɩn láhá mʋ ɔdɛ ɩwɩ tsu.

Ɔhá ánfɩ odu lamáɩ́n ɩwɩ lɛ́ Kristo amʋ́ʋ́ ógyi ɔpasua ámʋ nwun ámʋsʋ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔpasua ámʋtɔ anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ anɩlɛ́tsa abasʋ, Kristo amʋ́ʋ́ ogyi nwun ámʋ dɛ́ anɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́n wa, mɛ́nɩ abɛ́dan alɩá Bulu déklé.
Mlɩa Kristonyɔ lówu. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩtráa mlɩmá ɔyɩ́tɔ́ túmi kʋkʋ asɩ. Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩtráa mlɩdɛ́ mbla ánfɩ anásʋ́ gyí?
Bɛɛ, “Mágyi ɩ́nɩ. Mápʋ ɩbɩ da ɩ́nɩ, mátsu ɩ́nɩ ɛ́!”
Nɩ́ bɔpʋ́ ntobí ánfɩ fɛ́ɛ́ bwɛ́ atɔ́ tá á, iteyíntá. Anyánkpʋ́sa onutó mbla pʋ́ amʋ́ atosunáhɛ́ igyi.

Anɩdɛ́ mbla ánfɩ kɩ́ɩ fɛ́ tɔ́á nyánsa bʋ mʋ́tɔ́, ɩbɛ́ha abɔ́wa alɛ́ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́, abɛ́ba ɩwɩasɩ há mʋ, wá ɩwɩ ɔsɩn anɩaa ɩbɛ́ha abɛ́bɩ gyi ɩwɩsʋ. Támɛ ɩ́nɩ aná fɛ́ɛ́ ɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ há anɩméegyi ɩwɩsʋ.
